    r"|legally\s+enforceable\s+debt\s+or\s+other\s+liability",
    re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL,
)
NI_ANCHOR_RE = re.compile(
    r"\b(?:138|139|141|142|143a|148)\b|\bcheque\b|\bdraa?wee\b|\bdishonour",
    re.IGNORECASE,
)
CONTRACT_STRONG_RE = re.compile(
    r"(?:section|sec\.?|s\.)\s*(?:37|39|55|56|62|63|64|65|73|74|75)\b.{0,120}contract\s+act"
    r"|indian\s+contract\s+act.{0,120}(?:section|sec\.?|s\.)\s*(?:37|39|55|56|62|63|64|65|73|74|75)\b"
    r"|breach\s+of\s+contract.{0,200}(?:damages|liquidated|repudiat|specific\s+performance|section\s+7[34])"
    r"|liquidated\s+damages.{0,120}(?:section\s+74|penalty|breach)",
    re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL,
)
RBI_RE = re.compile(
    r"dishonour\s+of\s+cheque|cheque\s+truncation|negotiable\s+instruments\s+act|clearing\s+house"
    r"|electronic\s+clearing\s+service|national\s+automated\s+clearing|payment\s+and\s+settlement"
    r"|return\s+of\s+cheques|cheque\s+collection",
    re.IGNORECASE,
)
STATE_ACT_RE = re.compile(
    r"criminal\s+procedure|civil\s+procedure|contract|limitation|court[- ]fees|stamp|commercial\s+courts|arbitration",
    re.IGNORECASE,
)

# Regex patterns to extract case-to-case and case-to-statute citations for the local citation graph
CASE_CITATION_PATTERNS = (
    ("SCC", re.compile(r"\(\d{4}\)\s+\d+\s+SCC\s+(?:\(Cri\)\s+|(?:\(Civ\)\s+)?)?\d+")),
    ("AIR", re.compile(r"\bAIR\s+\d{4}\s+(?:SC|Del|Bom|Mad|Cal|All|Ker|Kar|Pat|P&H|Guj|Raj|AP|Ori)\s+\d+")),
    ("SCR", re.compile(r"\[\d{4}\]\s+(?:Supp\.?\s+)?\d*\s*S\.?C\.?R\.?\s+\d+")),
    ("INSC", re.compile(r"\b\d{4}\s+INSC\s+\d+\b")),
    ("NEUTRAL_HC", re.compile(r"\b\d{4}:(?:DHC|BHC(?:-AS|-OS|-AUG|-NAG|-GOA)?):\d+(?:-[A-Z]+)?\b")),
)
STATUTE_CITATION_RE = re.compile(
    r"\b(?:Section|Sec\.|Article)\s+\d+[A-Z]?(?:\(\d+\))?(?:\s+of\s+the\s+[A-Z][A-Za-z\s]{3,45}?Act(?:,\s*\d{4})?)?",
)


def _ssl_context() -> ssl.SSLContext:
    try:
        import truststore
        return truststore.SSLContext(ssl.PROTOCOL_TLS_CLIENT)
    except ImportError:
        return ssl.create_default_context()


SSL_CTX = _ssl_context()


def http_get(url: str, headers: dict[str, str] | None = None, timeout: int = 90, retries: int = 4) -> bytes:
    merged = {"User-Agent": USER_AGENT, **(headers or {})}
    last_err = None
    for attempt in range(retries):
        try:
            req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers=merged)
            with urllib.request.urlopen(req, context=SSL_CTX, timeout=timeout) as resp:
                return resp.read()
        except Exception as exc:
            last_err = exc
            if attempt + 1 < retries:
                time.sleep(1.5 * (attempt + 1))
    raise RuntimeError(f"GET failed for {url}: {last_err}") from last_err


def sha256_file(file_path: Path) -> str:
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with file_path.open("rb") as handle:
        for block in iter(lambda: handle.read(1 << 20), b""):
            digest.update(block)
    return digest.hexdigest()


class SparseBufferFile(io.RawIOBase):
    """In-memory sparse file wrapper allowing PyArrow to read only fetched byte segments."""

    def __init__(self, size: int, segments: list[tuple[int, bytes]]):
        self.size = size
        self.segments = sorted(segments, key=lambda item: item[0])
        self.pos = 0

    def readable(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def seekable(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def seek(self, offset: int, whence: int = io.SEEK_SET) -> int:
        if whence == io.SEEK_SET:
            self.pos = offset
        elif whence == io.SEEK_CUR:
            self.pos += offset
        elif whence == io.SEEK_END:
            self.pos = self.size + offset
        return self.pos

    def tell(self) -> int:
        return self.pos

    def read(self, n: int = -1) -> bytes:
        if self.pos >= self.size:
            return b""
        for start, buf in self.segments:
            end = start + len(buf)
            if start <= self.pos < end:
                rel = self.pos - start
                chunk = buf[rel:] if n < 0 else buf[rel : rel + n]
                self.pos += len(chunk)
                return chunk
        raise RuntimeError(f"Unbuffered Parquet read at offset={self.pos} length={n}")


def column_byte_span(rg_meta, col_indices: list[int]) -> tuple[int, int]:
    starts, ends = [], []
    for idx in col_indices:
        col = rg_meta.column(idx)
        start = col.dictionary_page_offset if col.has_dictionary_page and col.dictionary_page_offset else col.data_page_offset
        starts.append(start)
        ends.append(start + col.total_compressed_size)
    return min(starts), max(ends)


def fetch_range_segment(url: str, start: int, end: int) -> tuple[int, bytes]:
    data = http_get(url, headers={"Range": f"bytes={start}-{end - 1}"}, timeout=120)
    return start, data


def download_and_verify_legislation(raw_dir: Path) -> dict[str, dict]:
    raw_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    sums_payload = json.loads(http_get(f"{MIRROR_BASE}/SHA256SUMS.json"))
    expected_files = sums_payload.get("files", {})
    verified = {}
    for filename in LEGISLATION_FILES:
        expected = expected_files.get(filename)
        if not expected:
            raise RuntimeError(f"Missing checksum entry for {filename} in SHA256SUMS.json")
        dest = raw_dir / filename
        if not dest.exists() or dest.stat().st_size != expected["bytes"]:
            data = http_get(f"{MIRROR_BASE}/{filename}", timeout=180)
            dest.write_bytes(data)
        actual_sha = sha256_file(dest)
        if actual_sha != expected["sha256"]:
            raise RuntimeError(f"Checksum mismatch for {filename}: expected {expected['sha256']}, got {actual_sha}")
        verified[filename] = {"bytes": dest.stat().st_size, "sha256": actual_sha}
    return verified


def fetch_constitution_rows(raw_dir: Path) -> list[dict]:
    cache_path = raw_dir / "constitution_of_india.json"
    if not cache_path.exists():
        raw_bytes = http_get(
            CONSTITUTION_API_URL,
            headers={"Accept": "application/vnd.github.v3.raw"},
            timeout=60,
        )
        cache_path.write_bytes(raw_bytes)
    articles = json.loads(cache_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    rows = []
    for idx, item in enumerate(articles):
        art_num = str(item.get("article", idx))
        sec_title = (item.get("title") or f"Article {art_num}").strip()
        body = (item.get("description") or "").strip()
        if not body:
            continue
        text_lower = body.lower()
        rows.append({
            "act_id": "IND_constitution_1950",
            "chunk_id": f"IND_constitution_1950_art_{art_num}_{idx:03d}",
            "title": "The Constitution of India, 1950",
            "chapter": "Preamble" if art_num == "0" else "Articles",
            "section_number": "Preamble" if art_num == "0" else f"Article {art_num}",
            "section_title": sec_title,
            "section_type": "preamble" if art_num == "0" else "article",
            "text": f"The Constitution of India, 1950 - {'Preamble' if art_num == '0' else 'Article ' + art_num}: {sec_title}\n\n{body}",
            "jurisdiction": "central",
            "state": "central",
            "act_status": "in_force",
            "in_force": True,
            "doc_type": "constitution",
            "instrument_type": "constitution",
            "provision_type": "constitutional_article",
            "legal_subject": "constitutional_law",
            "has_proviso": "provided that" in text_lower or "provided further" in text_lower,
            "has_non_obstante": "notwithstanding anything" in text_lower,
            "delegation_type": None,
            "department": "Legislative Department, Ministry of Law and Justice",
            "regulatory_body": None,
            "acts_referenced": [],
            "defined_terms": [],
            "amendment_count": 0,
            "year": 1950,
            "language_code": "en",
            "source_publisher": "Legislative Department, Ministry of Law and Justice (India Code / CivicTech India)",
            "source_url": "https://legislative.gov.in/constitution-of-india/",
            "mirror_url": CONSTITUTION_API_URL,
            "domain": "constitution",
        })
    return rows


def extract_legislation_slice(raw_dir: Path, out_dir: Path) -> tuple[list[dict], dict]:
    rows: list[dict] = []
    counts_by_act: Counter = Counter()

    # 1. Central Legislation
    central_tbl = pq.read_table(raw_dir / "in_central_legislation.parquet")
    for row in central_tbl.to_pylist():
        if (row.get("language_code") or "en") != "en":
            continue
        act_id = row.get("act_id") or ""
        if act_id in TARGET_CENTRAL_ACTS:
            row["domain"] = TARGET_CENTRAL_ACTS[act_id]
            rows.append(row)
            counts_by_act[row.get("title") or act_id] += 1

    # 2. Constitution of India (465 articles normalized to LEGISLATION_SCHEMA + domain)
    const_rows = fetch_constitution_rows(raw_dir)
    rows.extend(const_rows)
    counts_by_act["The Constitution of India, 1950"] += len(const_rows)

    # 3. RBI Regulations on Cheque Dishonour, Clearing & Payment Systems
    rbi_tbl = pq.read_table(raw_dir / "in_rbi_regulations.parquet")
    for row in rbi_tbl.to_pylist():
        if (row.get("language_code") or "en") != "en":
            continue
        blob = f"{row.get('title') or ''} {row.get('section_title') or ''} {row.get('text') or ''}"
        if RBI_RE.search(blob):
            row["domain"] = "ni_act_138"
            rows.append(row)
            counts_by_act["RBI Cheque & Payment Directions"] += 1

    # 4. Delhi & Maharashtra State Legislation relevant to Commercial/Criminal Procedure/Contracts
    for state_file, label in (
        ("in_delhi_legislation.parquet", "Delhi State Commercial/Procedural Acts"),
        ("in_maharashtra_legislation.parquet", "Maharashtra State Commercial/Procedural Acts"),
    ):
        st_tbl = pq.read_table(raw_dir / state_file)
        for row in st_tbl.to_pylist():
            if (row.get("language_code") or "en") != "en":
                continue
            title = row.get("title") or ""
            if STATE_ACT_RE.search(title):
                row["domain"] = "both"
                rows.append(row)
                counts_by_act[label] += 1

    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    leg_parquet = out_dir / "target_legislation.parquet"
    leg_csv = out_dir / "target_legislation.csv"
    pq.write_table(pa.Table.from_pylist(rows), leg_parquet, compression="zstd")
    write_csv(rows, leg_csv)
    return rows, dict(counts_by_act)


def classify_case_domain(full_text: str, title: str, description: str) -> str | None:
    header_blob = f"{title}\n{description}\n{full_text}"
    is_ni = bool(NI_STRONG_RE.search(header_blob) and NI_ANCHOR_RE.search(header_blob))
    is_contract = bool(CONTRACT_STRONG_RE.search(header_blob))
    if is_ni and is_contract:
        return "both"
    if is_ni:
        return "ni_act_138"
    if is_contract:
        return "contract_breach"
    return None


def score_case(chunks: list[dict], domain: str) -> tuple[int, int, int, int]:
    first = chunks[0]
    court_rank = 2 if first.get("court_type") == "supreme_court" else 1
    bench = int(first.get("bench_strength") or 1)
    sec_types = {c.get("section_type") for c in chunks}
    has_core_sections = int(bool(sec_types & {"ratio_decidendi", "conclusion", "analysis", "judgment"})) + int(
        bool(sec_types & {"facts", "arguments", "issues"})
    )
    year = int(first.get("year") or 0)
    domain_bonus = 1 if domain in ("ni_act_138", "both") else 0
    return (court_rank, has_core_sections + domain_bonus, bench, year)


def select_row_group_indices(total_rgs: int, limit_rgs: int) -> list[int]:
    if limit_rgs <= 0 or limit_rgs >= total_rgs:
        return list(range(total_rgs))
    if limit_rgs == 1:
        return [0]
    return sorted({round(i * (total_rgs - 1) / (limit_rgs - 1)) for i in range(limit_rgs)})


def scan_court_judgments(
    court_key: str,
    row_group_limit: int,
    max_cases_per_domain: int,
    workers: int = 12,
) -> tuple[list[dict], dict]:
    filename, size = COURT_FILES[court_key]
    url = f"{MIRROR_BASE}/{filename}"
    footer_window = min(size, 2_200_000)
    _, footer_bytes = fetch_range_segment(url, size - footer_window, size)
    pf_meta = pq.ParquetFile(SparseBufferFile(size, [(size - len(footer_bytes), footer_bytes)]))
    schema_names = pf_meta.schema_arrow.names
    col_indices_before = [schema_names.index(c) for c in ("case_id", "chunk_id", "chunk_index", "total_chunks", "text")]
    col_indices_after = [
        schema_names.index(c)
        for c in JUDGMENT_READ_COLUMNS
        if c not in ("case_id", "chunk_id", "chunk_index", "total_chunks", "text")
    ]
    target_rgs = select_row_group_indices(pf_meta.num_row_groups, row_group_limit)

    def fetch_row_group(rg: int) -> tuple[int, list[dict], int]:
        rg_meta = pf_meta.metadata.row_group(rg)
        s1, e1 = column_byte_span(rg_meta, col_indices_before)
        s2, e2 = column_byte_span(rg_meta, col_indices_after)
        seg1 = fetch_range_segment(url, s1, e1)
        seg2 = fetch_range_segment(url, s2, e2)
        sbf = SparseBufferFile(size, [seg1, seg2, (size - len(footer_bytes), footer_bytes)])
        tbl = pq.ParquetFile(sbf).read_row_group(rg, columns=JUDGMENT_READ_COLUMNS)
        en_rows = [r for r in tbl.to_pylist() if r.get("language_code") == "en"]
        return rg, en_rows, (e1 - s1) + (e2 - s2)

    by_case: dict[str, list[dict]] = defaultdict(list)
    bytes_transferred = len(footer_bytes)
    t0 = time.monotonic()
    with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=workers) as pool:
        futures = [pool.submit(fetch_row_group, rg) for rg in target_rgs]
        for fut in concurrent.futures.as_completed(futures):
            _, en_rows, rg_bytes = fut.result()
            bytes_transferred += rg_bytes
            for row in en_rows:
                cid = row.get("case_id")
                if cid:
                    by_case[cid].append(row)

    # Keep only complete, ordered cases (0..total_chunks-1) that match our target legal domains
    candidates_by_domain: dict[str, list[tuple[tuple, str, list[dict]]]] = defaultdict(list)
    incomplete_dropped = 0
    for cid, case_chunks in by_case.items():
        dedup_by_idx = {}
        for ch in case_chunks:
            idx = ch.get("chunk_index")
            if idx is not None and idx not in dedup_by_idx:
                dedup_by_idx[int(idx)] = ch
        if not dedup_by_idx:
            continue
        ordered = [dedup_by_idx[i] for i in sorted(dedup_by_idx)]
        expected_total = int(ordered[0].get("total_chunks") or len(ordered))
        if len(ordered) != expected_total or [c["chunk_index"] for c in ordered] != list(range(expected_total)):
            incomplete_dropped += 1
            continue
        full_text = "\n".join(c.get("text") or "" for c in ordered)
        domain = classify_case_domain(full_text, ordered[0].get("title") or "", ordered[0].get("description") or "")
        if not domain:
            continue
        for c in ordered:
            c["domain"] = domain
        rank_key = score_case(ordered, domain)
        bucket = "ni_act_138" if domain in ("ni_act_138", "both") else "contract_breach"
        candidates_by_domain[bucket].append((rank_key, cid, ordered))
        if domain == "both":
            candidates_by_domain["contract_breach"].append((rank_key, cid, ordered))

    selected_cases: dict[str, list[dict]] = {}
    domain_case_counts: Counter = Counter()
    for dom in ("ni_act_138", "contract_breach"):
        ranked = sorted(candidates_by_domain[dom], key=lambda item: item[0], reverse=True)
        kept_for_dom = 0
        for _, cid, ordered in ranked:
            if cid not in selected_cases:
                selected_cases[cid] = ordered
                domain_case_counts[ordered[0]["domain"]] += 1
            kept_for_dom += 1
            if max_cases_per_domain > 0 and kept_for_dom >= max_cases_per_domain:
                break

    emitted_chunks = [ch for cid in sorted(selected_cases) for ch in selected_cases[cid]]
    elapsed = round(time.monotonic() - t0, 2)
    stats = {
        "file": filename,
        "row_groups_scanned": len(target_rgs),
        "total_row_groups": pf_meta.num_row_groups,
        "bytes_transferred": bytes_transferred,
        "english_cases_seen": len(by_case),
        "incomplete_boundary_cases_skipped": incomplete_dropped,
        "cases_selected": len(selected_cases),
        "chunks_selected": len(emitted_chunks),
        "domain_case_counts": dict(domain_case_counts),
        "elapsed_seconds": elapsed,
    }
    return emitted_chunks, stats


def extract_citations_for_cases(chunks: list[dict]) -> list[dict]:
    by_case: dict[str, list[dict]] = defaultdict(list)
    for ch in chunks:
        by_case[ch["case_id"]].append(ch)

    edges: list[dict] = []
    for cid, case_chunks in by_case.items():
        first = case_chunks[0]
        blob = "\n".join(c.get("text") or "" for c in case_chunks)
        seen_targets: set[tuple[str, str]] = set()
        for kind, pattern in CASE_CITATION_PATTERNS:
            for match in pattern.findall(blob):
                norm = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", match.strip())
                if (kind, norm) not in seen_targets:
                    seen_targets.add((kind, norm))
                    edges.append({
                        "source_case_id": cid,
                        "source_court": first.get("court") or "",
                        "source_year": first.get("year"),
                        "target_kind": f"case_{kind.lower()}",
                        "target_ref": norm,
                        "domain": first.get("domain") or "",
                    })
        for match in STATUTE_CITATION_RE.findall(blob):
            norm = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", match.strip())
            if ("statute", norm) not in seen_targets and len(seen_targets) < 60:
                seen_targets.add(("statute", norm))
                edges.append({
                    "source_case_id": cid,
                    "source_court": first.get("court") or "",
                    "source_year": first.get("year"),
                    "target_kind": "statute",
                    "target_ref": norm,
                    "domain": first.get("domain") or "",
                })
    return edges


def write_csv(rows: list[dict], path: Path) -> None:
    if not rows:
        path.write_text("", encoding="utf-8")
        return
    fieldnames = list(rows[0].keys())
    with path.open("w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as handle:
        writer = csv.DictWriter(handle, fieldnames=fieldnames)
        writer.writeheader()
        for row in rows:
            serialized = {
                k: (json.dumps(v, ensure_ascii=False) if isinstance(v, (list, dict)) else v)
                for k, v in row.items()
            }
            writer.writerow(serialized)


def build_sqlite_rag_db(
    db_path: Path,
    legislation_rows: list[dict],
    judgment_chunks: list[dict],
    citation_edges: list[dict],
) -> dict:
    db_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if db_path.exists():
        db_path.unlink()
    with closing(sqlite3.connect(db_path)) as conn, conn:
        conn.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL")
        conn.execute("PRAGMA synchronous=NORMAL")
        conn.execute(
            """
            CREATE TABLE legislation_provisions (
                chunk_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                act_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                domain TEXT NOT NULL,
                title TEXT NOT NULL,
                chapter TEXT,
                section_number TEXT,
                section_title TEXT,
                section_type TEXT,
                text TEXT NOT NULL,
                jurisdiction TEXT,
                state TEXT,
                act_status TEXT,
                in_force INTEGER,
                has_proviso INTEGER,
                has_non_obstante INTEGER,
                year INTEGER,
                source_publisher TEXT,
                source_url TEXT
            )
            """
        )
        conn.execute(
            """
            CREATE TABLE judgment_cases (
                case_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                domain TEXT NOT NULL,
                court TEXT NOT NULL,
                court_type TEXT NOT NULL,
                court_code TEXT,
                bench TEXT,
                bench_strength INTEGER,
                title TEXT,
                citation TEXT,
                case_number TEXT,
                decision_date TEXT,
                year INTEGER,
                disposition TEXT,
                petitioner TEXT,
                respondent TEXT,
                judges_json TEXT,
                total_chunks INTEGER NOT NULL,
                hierarchy_weight INTEGER NOT NULL
            )
            """
        )
        conn.execute(
            """
            CREATE TABLE judgment_chunks (
                chunk_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                case_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                chunk_index INTEGER NOT NULL,
                total_chunks INTEGER NOT NULL,
                domain TEXT NOT NULL,
                court TEXT NOT NULL,
                court_type TEXT NOT NULL,
                bench_strength INTEGER,
                year INTEGER,
                section_type TEXT,
                section_priority INTEGER,
                text TEXT NOT NULL,
                char_start INTEGER,
                char_end INTEGER,
                page_start INTEGER,
                page_end INTEGER,
                FOREIGN KEY(case_id) REFERENCES judgment_cases(case_id)
            )
            """
        )
        conn.execute(
            """
            CREATE TABLE case_citations (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                source_case_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                source_court TEXT,
                source_year INTEGER,
                target_kind TEXT NOT NULL,
                target_ref TEXT NOT NULL,
                domain TEXT
            )
            """
        )
        conn.execute(
            """
            CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE legal_fts USING fts5(
                item_id UNINDEXED,
                case_or_act_id UNINDEXED,
                category UNINDEXED,
                domain UNINDEXED,
                court_or_jurisdiction UNINDEXED,
                section_type UNINDEXED,
                hierarchy_weight UNINDEXED,
                title,
                text
            )
            """
        )

        for r in legislation_rows:
            conn.execute(
                """
                INSERT OR REPLACE INTO legislation_provisions VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)
                """,
                (
                    r.get("chunk_id") or f"{r.get('act_id')}_{r.get('section_number')}",
                    r.get("act_id") or "",
                    r.get("domain") or "both",
                    r.get("title") or "",
                    r.get("chapter"),
                    r.get("section_number"),
                    r.get("section_title"),
                    r.get("section_type"),
                    r.get("text") or "",
                    r.get("jurisdiction"),
                    r.get("state"),
                    r.get("act_status"),
                    int(bool(r.get("in_force"))),
                    int(bool(r.get("has_proviso"))),
                    int(bool(r.get("has_non_obstante"))),
                    r.get("year"),
                    r.get("source_publisher"),
                    r.get("source_url"),
                ),
            )
            conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO legal_fts VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
                (
                    r.get("chunk_id") or "",
                    r.get("act_id") or "",
                    "legislation",
                    r.get("domain") or "both",
                    r.get("jurisdiction") or "central",
                    r.get("section_type") or "section",
                    100,
                    f"{r.get('title') or ''} {r.get('section_number') or ''} {r.get('section_title') or ''}",
                    r.get("text") or "",
                ),
            )

        cases_seen = {}
        for ch in judgment_chunks:
            cid = ch["case_id"]
            if cid not in cases_seen:
                is_sc = ch.get("court_type") == "supreme_court"
                bench = int(ch.get("bench_strength") or 1)
                weight = (200 if is_sc else 100) + min(bench, 15) * 5
                cases_seen[cid] = (
                    cid,
                    ch.get("domain") or "",
                    ch.get("court") or "",
                    ch.get("court_type") or "",
                    ch.get("court_code"),
                    ch.get("bench"),
                    bench,
                    ch.get("title"),
                    ch.get("citation"),
                    ch.get("case_number"),
                    ch.get("decision_date"),
                    ch.get("year"),
                    ch.get("disposition"),
                    ch.get("petitioner"),
                    ch.get("respondent"),
                    json.dumps(ch.get("judges") or [], ensure_ascii=False),
                    int(ch.get("total_chunks") or 1),
                    weight,
                )
        conn.executemany(
            "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO judgment_cases VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
            list(cases_seen.values()),
        )

        for ch in judgment_chunks:
            cid = ch["case_id"]
            weight = cases_seen[cid][-1] + int(ch.get("section_priority") or 30)
            conn.execute(
                "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO judgment_chunks VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
                (
                    ch.get("chunk_id") or f"{cid}_{ch.get('chunk_index', 0):03d}",
                    cid,
                    int(ch.get("chunk_index") or 0),
                    int(ch.get("total_chunks") or 1),
                    ch.get("domain") or "",
                    ch.get("court") or "",
                    ch.get("court_type") or "",
                    int(ch.get("bench_strength") or 1),
                    ch.get("year"),
                    ch.get("section_type") or "body",
                    int(ch.get("section_priority") or 30),
                    ch.get("text") or "",
                    ch.get("char_start"),
                    ch.get("char_end"),
                    ch.get("page_start"),
                    ch.get("page_end"),
                ),
            )
            conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO legal_fts VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
                (
                    ch.get("chunk_id") or f"{cid}_{ch.get('chunk_index', 0):03d}",
                    cid,
                    "judgment",
                    ch.get("domain") or "",
                    ch.get("court") or "",
                    ch.get("section_type") or "body",
                    weight,
                    f"{ch.get('title') or ''} {ch.get('citation') or ''} {ch.get('case_number') or ''}",
                    ch.get("text") or "",
                ),
            )

        conn.executemany(
            """
            INSERT INTO case_citations (source_case_id, source_court, source_year, target_kind, target_ref, domain)
            VALUES (:source_case_id, :source_court, :source_year, :target_kind, :target_ref, :domain)
            """,
            citation_edges,
        )
        conn.execute("CREATE INDEX idx_judgment_chunks_case ON judgment_chunks(case_id, chunk_index)")
        conn.execute("CREATE INDEX idx_judgment_cases_domain ON judgment_cases(domain, court_type, bench_strength DESC)")
        conn.execute("CREATE INDEX idx_citations_source ON case_citations(source_case_id)")
        conn.execute("CREATE INDEX idx_citations_target ON case_citations(target_ref)")

    return {
        "db_path": str(db_path),
        "db_bytes": db_path.stat().st_size,
        "legislation_provisions": len(legislation_rows),
        "judgment_cases": len(cases_seen),
        "judgment_chunks": len(judgment_chunks),
        "citation_edges": len(citation_edges),
    }


def search_legal_corpus(
    db_path: str | Path,
    query: str,
    domain: str | None = None,
    category: str | None = None,
    limit: int = 10,
) -> list[dict]:
    """Query the local SQLite FTS5 legal store with BM25 + court/section hierarchy weighting."""
    terms = list(dict.fromkeys(re.findall(r"[A-Za-z0-9]+", query)))[:14]
    if not terms:
        return []
    expression = " OR ".join(f'"{t}"' for t in terms)
    clauses = ["legal_fts MATCH ?"]
    params: list[object] = [expression]
    if domain:
        clauses.append("(domain = ? OR domain = 'both' OR domain = 'constitution')")
        params.append(domain)
    if category:
        clauses.append("category = ?")
        params.append(category)
    params.append(max(1, min(int(limit), 50)))
    sql = f"""
        SELECT item_id, case_or_act_id, category, domain, court_or_jurisdiction,
               section_type, CAST(hierarchy_weight AS INTEGER) AS weight, title,
               substr(text, 1, 700) AS snippet, bm25(legal_fts) AS bm25_score
        FROM legal_fts
        WHERE {' AND '.join(clauses)}
        ORDER BY (bm25(legal_fts) - (CAST(hierarchy_weight AS REAL) * 0.02)) ASC
        LIMIT ?
    """
    with closing(sqlite3.connect(db_path)) as conn:
        conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
        return [dict(row) for row in conn.execute(sql, params).fetchall()]


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--out-dir", type=Path, default=Path("data/open_india_law"))
    parser.add_argument("--sc-row-groups", type=int, default=56, help="Row groups to scan for Supreme Court (56 = 100%% of SC)")
    parser.add_argument("--hc-row-groups", type=int, default=6, help="Evenly spaced row groups per High Court (0 = all)")
    parser.add_argument("--max-cases-per-domain", type=int, default=600, help="Max complete cases per court per domain")
    parser.add_argument("--workers", type=int, default=12)
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)

    raw_dir = args.out_dir / "raw"
    print("1. Verifying and downloading legislation & regulatory Parquet files...", flush=True)
    verified_files = download_and_verify_legislation(raw_dir)
    for name, info in verified_files.items():
        print(f"   verified {name}: {info['bytes']/1e6:.2f} MB (sha256={info['sha256'][:12]}...)", flush=True)

    print("2. Extracting statutory, constitutional, and RBI regulatory provisions...", flush=True)
    legislation_rows, act_counts = extract_legislation_slice(raw_dir, args.out_dir)
    for title, count in sorted(act_counts.items(), key=lambda kv: -kv[1]):
        print(f"   {count:5,d} provisions | {title}", flush=True)

    print("3. Extracting complete multi-chunk English judgments (Supreme Court + Delhi HC + Bombay HC)...", flush=True)
    all_judgment_chunks: list[dict] = []
    court_stats = {}
    for court_key, rg_limit in (
        ("supreme_court", args.sc_row_groups),
        ("delhi", args.hc_row_groups),
        ("bombay", args.hc_row_groups),
    ):
        print(f"   scanning {court_key} (row_groups={rg_limit})...", flush=True)
        chunks, st = scan_court_judgments(
            court_key=court_key,
            row_group_limit=rg_limit,
            max_cases_per_domain=args.max_cases_per_domain,
            workers=args.workers,
        )
        all_judgment_chunks.extend(chunks)
        court_stats[court_key] = st
        print(
            f"   -> {court_key}: {st['cases_selected']:,} complete cases ({st['chunks_selected']:,} chunks) "
            f"in {st['elapsed_seconds']}s ({st['bytes_transferred']/1e6:.1f} MB transferred)",
            flush=True,
        )

    judgments_parquet = args.out_dir / "domain_judgments.parquet"
    judgments_csv = args.out_dir / "domain_judgments.csv"
    pq.write_table(pa.Table.from_pylist(all_judgment_chunks), judgments_parquet, compression="zstd")
    write_csv(all_judgment_chunks, judgments_csv)

    print("4. Extracting citation graph edges & building SQLite + FTS5 RAG database...", flush=True)
    citation_edges = extract_citations_for_cases(all_judgment_chunks)
    db_summary = build_sqlite_rag_db(
        args.out_dir / "legal_poc.db",
        legislation_rows=legislation_rows,
        judgment_chunks=all_judgment_chunks,
        citation_edges=citation_edges,
    )

    manifest = {
        "dataset": "open-india-law",
        "version": "v2026.08.1",
        "domains": ["ni_act_138", "contract_breach", "constitution"],
        "verified_legislation_files": verified_files,
        "legislation_counts_by_source": act_counts,
        "courts": court_stats,
        "outputs": {
            "target_legislation_parquet": str(args.out_dir / "target_legislation.parquet"),
            "target_legislation_csv": str(args.out_dir / "target_legislation.csv"),
            "domain_judgments_parquet": str(judgments_parquet),
            "domain_judgments_csv": str(judgments_csv),
            "sqlite_rag_db": db_summary,
        },
    }
    manifest_path = args.out_dir / "extraction_manifest.json"
    manifest_path.write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"Done! Manifest written to {manifest_path}", flush=True)
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

import json
import sqlite3
import unittest
from contextlib import closing
from pathlib import Path

import pyarrow.parquet as pq

from scripts.extract_open_india_law import search_legal_corpus

DATA_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "data" / "open_india_law"


class OpenIndiaLawExtractionTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_extracted_artifacts_and_manifest(self):
        manifest_path = DATA_DIR / "extraction_manifest.json"
        self.assertTrue(manifest_path.exists())
        manifest = json.loads(manifest_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        self.assertEqual(manifest["dataset"], "open-india-law")
        self.assertEqual(manifest["version"], "v2026.08.1")
        for key in ("target_legislation_parquet", "target_legislation_csv", "domain_judgments_parquet", "domain_judgments_csv"):
            artifact = Path(manifest["outputs"][key])
            self.assertTrue(artifact.exists(), f"Missing artifact {artifact}")
            self.assertGreater(artifact.stat().st_size, 100_000)

    def test_legislation_slice_completeness(self):
        table = pq.read_table(DATA_DIR / "target_legislation.parquet")
        rows = table.to_pylist()
        self.assertGreaterEqual(len(rows), 7000)
        self.assertTrue(all(r["language_code"] == "en" for r in rows))

        act_ids = {r["act_id"] for r in rows}
        for required_act in (
            "IND_constitution_1950",
            "IND_central_2189",  # Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881
            "IND_central_2187",  # Indian Contract Act, 1872
            "IND_central_1583",  # Specific Relief Act, 1963
            "IND_central_1565",  # Limitation Act, 1963
            "IND_central_2082",  # Payment and Settlement Systems Act, 2007
        ):
            self.assertIn(required_act, act_ids)

        ni_sections = {str(r["section_number"]) for r in rows if r["act_id"] == "IND_central_2189"}
        self.assertIn("138", ni_sections)
        self.assertIn("139", ni_sections)
        self.assertIn("141", ni_sections)
        self.assertIn("142", ni_sections)

        contract_sections = {str(r["section_number"]) for r in rows if r["act_id"] == "IND_central_2187"}
        self.assertIn("56", contract_sections)
        self.assertIn("73", contract_sections)
        self.assertIn("74", contract_sections)

        const_articles = {str(r["section_number"]) for r in rows if r["act_id"] == "IND_constitution_1950"}
        self.assertIn("Article 32", const_articles)
        self.assertIn("Article 136", const_articles)
        self.assertIn("Article 141", const_articles)
        self.assertIn("Article 226", const_articles)

    def test_whole_case_judgment_integrity(self):
        table = pq.read_table(DATA_DIR / "domain_judgments.parquet")
        rows = table.to_pylist()
        self.assertGreaterEqual(len(rows), 5000)
        self.assertTrue(all(r["language_code"] == "en" for r in rows))

        courts = {r["court"] for r in rows}
        self.assertIn("Supreme Court of India", courts)
        self.assertTrue(any("Delhi" in c for c in courts))
        self.assertTrue(any("Bombay" in c for c in courts))

        by_case = {}
        for row in rows:
            by_case.setdefault(row["case_id"], []).append(row)
        self.assertGreaterEqual(len(by_case), 1000)

        for case_id, chunks in by_case.items():
            indices = [int(c["chunk_index"]) for c in chunks]
            expected_total = int(chunks[0]["total_chunks"])
            self.assertEqual(
                indices,
                list(range(expected_total)),
                f"Fragmented chunks for {case_id}: got {indices}, expected 0..{expected_total - 1}",
            )

    def test_sqlite_fts5_retrieval_and_citations(self):
        db_path = DATA_DIR / "legal_poc.db"
        self.assertTrue(db_path.exists())
        with closing(sqlite3.connect(db_path)) as conn:
            citation_count = conn.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM case_citations").fetchone()[0]
            self.assertGreater(citation_count, 5000)

        ni_hits = search_legal_corpus(
            db_path,
            "Section 138 Negotiable Instruments Act dishonour of cheque statutory notice security cheque",
            domain="ni_act_138",
            limit=12,
        )
        self.assertTrue(ni_hits)
        self.assertTrue(any("138" in h["snippet"] or "138" in h["title"] for h in ni_hits))

        contract_hits = search_legal_corpus(
            db_path,
            "Section 73 Section 74 Indian Contract Act breach of contract liquidated damages",
            domain="contract_breach",
            limit=12,
        )
        self.assertTrue(contract_hits)
        self.assertTrue(any("73" in h["snippet"] or "74" in h["snippet"] or "breach" in h["snippet"].lower() for h in contract_hits))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

repair_legislation_row(row: dict) -> dict:
    """Fix footnote-mislabelled section_number values in Vaquill's India Code parser output."""
    text = row.get("text") or ""
    cid = row.get("chunk_id") or ""
    if cid == "IND_central_2187_s001_d4" or (
        cid.startswith("IND_central_2187_s002_p") and "OF THE CONSEQUENCES OF BREACH OF CONTRACT" in text
    ):
        row["section_number"] = "73"
        row["section_title"] = "Compensation for loss or damage caused by breach of contract"

    sec_num = str(row.get("section_number") or "").strip()
    if (not sec_num or sec_num in {"1", "2", "3"}) and FOOTNOTE_HEADER_RE.search(text[:320]):

### 2. Breakdown of Extracted Data

- **Legislation, Constitution & Regulations (7,143 provisions):**
  - *The Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881* (`IND_central_2189`): 178 provisions (including Sections 138–148)
  - *The Indian Contract Act, 1872* (`IND_central_2187`): 196 provisions (including Sections 1–75)

  - *The Limitation Act, 1963* (`IND_central_1565`): 72 provisions

  - *The Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996* (`IND_central_1978`): 248 provisions
  - *The Code of Civil Procedure, 1908* (`IND_central_2191`): 1,554 provisions
  - *The Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023* (`IND_central_20099`): 827 provisions
  - *The Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023* (`IND_central_20063`) & *The Indian Evidence Act, 1872* (`IND_REP_971_1872`): 484 provisions
  - *The Constitution of India, 1950* (`IND_constitution_1950`): 465 articles + Preamble
  - *RBI Cheque Dishonour & Payment Directions*: 973 provisions
  - *Delhi & Maharashtra State Commercial/Procedural Acts*: 2,023 provisions
- **Complete Multi-Chunk English Judgments (1,600 cases / 10,139 chunks):**
  - **Supreme Court of India:** 318 complete cases (4,811 chunks)
  - **Delhi High Court:** 665 complete cases (3,626 chunks)
  - **Bombay High Court:** 617 complete cases (1,702 chunks)

### 3. Upstream Dataset Defects Caught & Repaired During Extraction

1. **Missing Constitution in `in_central_legislation.parquet`:** Contrary to the earlier AI chat claim, Vaquill's `in_central_legislation.parquet` contains `0` rows of the Constitution of India.

fetches and normalizes all 465 Articles of the Constitution of India into the exact `LEGISLATION_SCHEMA`.
2. **Mislabelled Section 73 of the Indian Contract Act:** In Vaquill's `in_central_legislation.parquet`, a footnote before Chapter VI caused Section 73 (*Compensation for loss or damage caused by breach of contract*) and its illustrations `(a)`–`(r)` to be mislabelled as `section_number = "1"` and `"2"` (`IND_central_2187_s001_d4` and `IND_central_2187_s002_p0..p6`).

repairs those section numbers and titles automatically.
3. **2-Range Coalesced Columnar Streaming:** Each judgment Parquet file stores both
and an identical `text_original` column (4.8 GB of duplicate data across the three courts).

reads only the required column byte spans over HTTP `Range` requests, skipping `text_original` and verifying contiguous chunks (`0..total_chunks-1`) for every case.

"""Indian legal RAG retrieval over data/open_india_law/legal_poc.db (stdlib sqlite3 + FTS5)."""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import re
import sqlite3
from contextlib import closing
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
DEFAULT_LEGAL_DB = ROOT / "data" / "open_india_law" / "legal_poc.db"

DOMAIN_LABELS = {
    "ni_act_138": "Cheque Dishonour & Banking (Section 138 Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881 + RBI Directions)",
    "contract_breach": "Commercial Breach of Contract & Damages (Indian Contract Act, 1872 + Specific Relief Act, 1963)",
    "constitution": "Constitutional Writ, Appellate & Limitation Jurisdiction (Constitution of India, 1950 + Limitation Act, 1963)",
    "both": "Commercial Contract & Cheque Dishonour Dispute (NI Act, 1881 + Indian Contract Act, 1872)",
}

SAMPLE_SCENARIOS = {
    "ni_act_138": (
        "A Bengaluru electronics distributor issued a post-dated cheque for Rs. 35,00,000 marked as a security deposit "
        "under a dealership supply agreement with a Mumbai manufacturer. After a dispute over delayed and defective shipments, "
        "the distributor instructed its bank to stop payment, and the cheque was returned unpaid with memo 'Payment Stopped by Drawer'. "
        "The manufacturer sent a statutory demand notice 28 days after receiving the bank return memo; the distributor replied "
        "claiming the cheque was given purely by way of security and no crystallized debt was due on the date of drawal. "
        "The manufacturer now files a complaint under Section 138 read with Section 141 of the Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881 "
        "against the company and its non-executive directors."
    ),
    "contract_breach": (
        "An infrastructure contractor entered into a fixed-price turnkey supply and installation contract in Delhi with "
        "a stipulated liquidated damages clause of 10% of the contract value for delay under Section 74 of the Indian Contract Act, 1872. "
        "Midway through performance, sudden port restrictions and customs notifications delayed imported components by four months. "
        "The employer terminated the contract for repudiatory breach, forfeited the entire 10% performance bank guarantee without "
        "proving actual loss, and procured replacement equipment at a higher price. The contractor claims frustration and extension "
        "of time under Sections 55 and 56, challenges the forfeiture under Sections 73 and 74, and seeks an injunction."
    ),
    "constitution": (
        "A state procurement authority blacklisted an MSME engineering supplier for three years and invoked its earnest money deposit "
        "without issuing a specific show-cause notice proposing blacklisting or granting a personal hearing. The supplier challenges "
        "the order directly before the High Court under Article 226 of the Constitution of India alleging violation of Article 14 "
        "and natural justice, while the state authority objects that the contract contains an arbitration clause and a civil remedy."
    ),
}

# Core statutory chunk_ids per domain so essential statutory ingredients & loopholes are always included
ANCHOR_CHUNKS = {
    "ni_act_138": [
        "IND_central_2189_s138_p0",
        "IND_central_2189_s138_p1",
        "IND_central_2189_s139",
        "IND_central_2189_s141_p0",
        "IND_central_2189_s142_p0",
        "IND_constitution_1950_art_141_153",
    ],
    "contract_breach": [
        "IND_central_2187_s001_d4",  # Repaired Section 73 main text
        "IND_central_2187_s074_p0",  # Section 74 liquidated damages / penalty
        "IND_central_2187_s055_p0",  # Section 55 time of essence
        "IND_central_2187_s056_p0",  # Section 56 impossibility / frustration
        "IND_central_2187_s039_p0",  # Section 39 refusal to perform promise wholly
        "IND_constitution_1950_art_141_153",
    ],
    "constitution": [
        "IND_constitution_1950_art_14_16",
        "IND_constitution_1950_art_19_22",
        "IND_constitution_1950_art_32_37",
        "IND_constitution_1950_art_136_147",
        "IND_constitution_1950_art_141_153",
        "IND_constitution_1950_art_226_239",
    ],
}

STOPWORDS = {
    "the", "and", "for", "with", "that", "this", "from", "under", "into", "after", "before", "were",
    "was", "are", "has", "had", "have", "its", "their", "they", "them", "who", "whom", "which", "what",
    "when", "where", "why", "how", "any", "all", "both", "each", "other", "some", "such", "no", "nor",
    "not", "only", "own", "same", "than", "too", "very", "can", "will", "just", "should", "now", "case",
}


def detect_legal_domain(text: str, requested: str = "auto") -> str:
    if requested in ("ni_act_138", "contract_breach", "constitution", "both"):
        return requested
    lower = (text or "").lower()
    is_ni = any(
        k in lower
        for k in ("138", "139", "141", "142", "cheque", "dishonour", "negotiable instrument", "drawer", "drawee", "return memo")
    )
    is_con = any(
        k in lower
        for k in (
            "breach", "contract", "liquidated damages", "section 73", "section 74", "section 55", "section 56",
            "frustration", "specific performance", "forfeiture", "bank guarantee", "termination", "repudiat",
        )
    )
    is_const = any(
        k in lower
        for k in ("article 14", "article 19", "article 21", "article 32", "article 136", "article 226", "writ", "fundamental right", "unconstitutional")
    )
    if is_ni and is_con:
        return "both"
    if is_ni:
        return "ni_act_138"
    if is_con:
        return "contract_breach"
    if is_const:
        return "constitution"
    return "ni_act_138"


def legal_status(db_path: Path = DEFAULT_LEGAL_DB) -> dict:
    path = Path(db_path)
    if not path.exists():
        return {"available": False, "domains": list(DOMAIN_LABELS)}
    try:
        with closing(sqlite3.connect(path)) as conn:
            provisions = conn.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legislation_provisions").fetchone()[0]
            cases = conn.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM judgment_cases").fetchone()[0]
            chunks = conn.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM judgment_chunks").fetchone()[0]
            citations = conn.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM case_citations").fetchone()[0]
        return {
            "available": True,
            "dataset": "vaquill/open-india-law",
            "version": "v2026.08.1",
            "legislation_provisions": provisions,
            "judgment_cases": cases,
            "judgment_chunks": chunks,
            "citation_edges": citations,
            "domains": list(DOMAIN_LABELS),
        }
    except sqlite3.Error:
        return {"available": False, "domains": list(DOMAIN_LABELS)}


def _fts_expression(query: str) -> str:
    tokens = [
        t for t in dict.fromkeys(re.findall(r"[A-Za-z0-9]+", query or ""))
        if (len(t) >= 3 or t.isdigit()) and t.lower() not in STOPWORDS
    ][:16]
    if not tokens:
        tokens = ["Section", "138", "73", "74", "Contract", "Cheque"]
    return " OR ".join(f'"{t}"' for t in tokens)


def _clean_excerpt(text: str, max_len: int = 440) -> str:
    cleaned = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", (text or "").strip())
    if len(cleaned) <= max_len:
        return cleaned
    cut = cleaned[:max_len].rsplit(" ", 1)[0]
    return cut + "."


def retrieve_legal_dossier(
    scenario: str,
    domain: str = "auto",
    max_chars: int = 5400,
    db_path: Path = DEFAULT_LEGAL_DB,
) -> dict:
    """Build a citation-grounded Indian legal source dossier for a scenario from legal_poc.db."""
    path = Path(db_path)
    if not path.exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError("Indian legal corpus database (data/open_india_law/legal_poc.db) is not initialized.")

    resolved_domain = detect_legal_domain(scenario, domain)
    effective_scenario = (scenario or "").strip()
    if not effective_scenario:
        sample_key = "ni_act_138" if resolved_domain == "both" else resolved_domain
        effective_scenario = SAMPLE_SCENARIOS.get(sample_key, SAMPLE_SCENARIOS["ni_act_138"])
        resolved_domain = detect_legal_domain(effective_scenario, domain)

    fts_expr = _fts_expression(effective_scenario)
    anchor_ids: list[str] = []
    if resolved_domain == "both":
        anchor_ids = ANCHOR_CHUNKS["ni_act_138"][:3] + ANCHOR_CHUNKS["contract_breach"][:3]
    else:
        anchor_ids = list(ANCHOR_CHUNKS.get(resolved_domain, ANCHOR_CHUNKS["ni_act_138"]))

    with closing(sqlite3.connect(path)) as conn:
        conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row

        # 1. Fetch statutory anchors + FTS-matched provisions
        statutes_by_id: dict[str, dict] = {}
        if anchor_ids:
            placeholders = ",".join("?" for _ in anchor_ids)
            for row in conn.execute(
                f"SELECT * FROM legislation_provisions WHERE chunk_id IN ({placeholders})",
                anchor_ids,
            ).fetchall():
                statutes_by_id[row["chunk_id"]] = dict(row)

        dom_clause = (
            "AND l.domain IN ('ni_act_138', 'contract_breach', 'both', 'constitution')"
            if resolved_domain == "both"
            else "AND l.domain IN (?, 'both', 'constitution')"
        )
        dom_params = [fts_expr] if resolved_domain == "both" else [fts_expr, resolved_domain]
        fts_statutes = conn.execute(
            f"""
            SELECT l.*
            FROM legal_fts f
            JOIN legislation_provisions l ON l.chunk_id = f.item_id
            WHERE f.legal_fts MATCH ? AND f.category = 'legislation' {dom_clause}
            ORDER BY bm25(f.legal_fts) ASC
            LIMIT 8
            """,
            dom_params,
        ).fetchall()
        for row in fts_statutes:
            if len(statutes_by_id) >= 6:
                break
            statutes_by_id.setdefault(row["chunk_id"], dict(row))

        statutes = list(statutes_by_id.values())[:6]

        # 2. Retrieve top precedent cases (prioritizing Supreme Court + high section_priority chunks)
        j_dom_clause = (
            "AND c.domain IN ('ni_act_138', 'contract_breach', 'both')"
            if resolved_domain in ("both", "constitution")
            else "AND c.domain IN (?, 'both')"
        )
        j_params = [fts_expr] if resolved_domain in ("both", "constitution") else [fts_expr, resolved_domain]
        chunk_hits = conn.execute(
            f"""
            SELECT jc.chunk_id, jc.case_id, jc.chunk_index, jc.section_type, jc.section_priority,
                   jc.text, c.court, c.court_type, c.bench_strength, c.title, c.citation,
                   c.case_number, c.decision_date, c.year, c.disposition, c.hierarchy_weight,
                   bm25(f.legal_fts) AS bm25_score
            FROM legal_fts f
            JOIN judgment_chunks jc ON jc.chunk_id = f.item_id
            JOIN judgment_cases c ON c.case_id = jc.case_id
            WHERE f.legal_fts MATCH ? AND f.category = 'judgment' {j_dom_clause}
            ORDER BY (bm25(f.legal_fts) - (c.hierarchy_weight * 0.035) - (jc.section_priority * 0.02)) ASC
            LIMIT 40
            """,
            j_params,
        ).fetchall()

        selected_cases: dict[str, dict] = {}
        for row in chunk_hits:
            cid = row["case_id"]
            if cid not in selected_cases:
                if len(selected_cases) >= 5:
                    continue
                cites = [
                    r["target_ref"]
                    for r in conn.execute(
                        "SELECT target_ref FROM case_citations WHERE source_case_id = ? LIMIT 5",
                        (cid,),
                    ).fetchall()
                ]
                # Also fetch the case's highest-priority ratio/conclusion/arguments chunk if different
                best_chunks = conn.execute(
                    """
                    SELECT chunk_index, section_type, section_priority, text
                    FROM judgment_chunks
                    WHERE case_id = ?
                    ORDER BY CASE
                        WHEN section_type IN ('ratio_decidendi', 'conclusion', 'judgment', 'analysis') THEN 2
                        WHEN section_type IN ('arguments', 'issues', 'facts') THEN 1
                        ELSE 0
                    END DESC, section_priority DESC, chunk_index ASC
                    LIMIT 2
                    """,
                    (cid,),
                ).fetchall()
                excerpts = [_clean_excerpt(row["text"], 420)]
                for b in best_chunks:
                    ex = _clean_excerpt(b["text"], 360)
                    if ex and ex not in excerpts and len(excerpts) < 2:
                        excerpts.append(ex)
                selected_cases[cid] = {
                    "case_id": cid,
                    "title": row["title"] or cid,
                    "court": row["court"] or "High Court",
                    "court_type": row["court_type"] or "high_court",
                    "bench_strength": int(row["bench_strength"] or 1),
                    "year": row["year"],
                    "decision_date": (row["decision_date"] or "")[:10],
                    "citation": row["citation"] or row["case_number"] or cid,
                    "disposition": row["disposition"] or "DECIDED",
                    "section_type": row["section_type"] or "judgment",
                    "citations_extracted": cites,
                    "excerpts": excerpts,
                }

    precedents = list(selected_cases.values())

    # 3. Format the verbatim-quote-friendly Indian Legal Source Dossier within max_chars
    lines = [
        f"INDIAN JURISDICTION LEGAL DOSSIER (Open India Law v2026.08.1 — {DOMAIN_LABELS.get(resolved_domain, resolved_domain)})",
        "Court Hierarchy & Precedent Rule: Under Article 141 of the Constitution of India, law declared by the Supreme Court of India is binding on all High Courts and subordinate courts. A larger Bench binds a smaller or co-ordinate Bench.",
        "",
        "=== I. APPLICABLE STATUTORY, CONSTITUTIONAL & REGULATORY PROVISIONS ===",
    ]
    for idx, st in enumerate(statutes, 1):
        flags = []
        if st.get("has_proviso"):
            flags.append("HAS_PROVISO_EXCEPTION")
        if st.get("has_non_obstante"):
            flags.append("NON_OBSTANTE_OVERRIDE")
        flag_str = f" [{', '.join(flags)}]" if flags else ""
        sec_label = st.get("section_number") or "Provision"
        lines.append(
            f"[{idx}] {st.get('title')} — Section/Article {sec_label} ({st.get('act_status') or 'in_force'}){flag_str}: "
            f"{_clean_excerpt(st.get('text') or '', 420)}"
        )

    lines.append("")
    lines.append("=== II. BINDING SUPREME COURT & HIGH COURT PRECEDENTS ===")
    for idx, pr in enumerate(precedents, 1):
        cite_str = f" | Cited authorities: {', '.join(pr['citations_extracted'][:4])}" if pr["citations_extracted"] else ""
        lines.append(
            f"[P{idx}] {pr['title']} ({pr['citation']}) — {pr['court']} "
            f"(Bench strength: {pr['bench_strength']}, Date: {pr['decision_date'] or pr['year']}, Disposition: {pr['disposition']}{cite_str}): "
            + " ".join(pr["excerpts"])
        )

    dossier = "\n".join(lines).strip()
    if len(dossier) > max_chars:
        dossier = dossier[: max_chars - 1].rsplit(" ", 1)[0] + "."

    return {
        "domain": resolved_domain,
        "domain_label": DOMAIN_LABELS.get(resolved_domain, resolved_domain),
        "scenario": effective_scenario,
        "source": dossier,
        "statutes_count": len(statutes),
        "precedents_count": len(precedents),
        "statutes": [
            {
                "chunk_id": s["chunk_id"],
                "title": s["title"],
                "section_number": s["section_number"],
                "has_proviso": bool(s["has_proviso"]),
                "has_non_obstante": bool(s["has_non_obstante"]),
            }
            for s in statutes

### What Was Added

1. **Indian Legal RAG Dossier Builder (

):**
   - Queries
using stdlib

+ FTS5 (`bm25()`) with zero external server dependencies.
   - Auto-detects or accepts a specific legal domain (`ni_act_138`, `contract_breach`, `constitution`, or `both`) and pulls:
     - **Core Statutory & Constitutional Anchors + FTS Matches:** Sections 138, 139, 141, 142 of the *Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881*, Sections 39, 55, 56, 73, 74 of the *Indian Contract Act, 1872*, *Specific Relief Act, 1963*, *Limitation Act, 1963*, *RBI Directions*, and *Articles 14, 19, 32, 136, 141, 226 of the Constitution of India*, with `[HAS_PROVISO_EXCEPTION]` and `[NON_OBSTANTE_OVERRIDE]` flags for statutory loophole analysis.
     - **Binding Supreme Court & High Court Precedents:** Ranks chunks from the Supreme Court of India, Delhi High Court, and Bombay High Court by court hierarchy (`supreme_court` > `high_court`), `bench_strength`, and `section_priority` (`ratio_decidendi`,

, `analysis`, `arguments`, `facts`), attaching extracted case/statute citations from `case_citations`.
   - Formats the result into a `<= 5,400`-character dossier so
in

extracts the verbatim legal evidence graph in a single batch call.

):**
   - `GET /api/config` now exposes `legal_corpus` availability and counts (`7,143` provisions, `1,600` complete cases, `10,139` chunks, `12,714` citations).

), you can now pick a domain in **Indian Legal Corpus (RAG)** and click **Retrieve Law & Cases** to populate **Source Context** with the matching Indian statutes and Supreme Court/High Court precedents (or auto-fill a sample Indian dispute scenario if the scenario box is empty) before clicking **Prepare Experiment**.

def retrieve_turn_authorities(
    scenario: str,
    recent_lines: list[str],
    speaker_role: str = "",
    db_path: Path = DEFAULT_LEGAL_DB,
    limit_statutes: int = 3,
    limit_precedents: int = 3,
) -> dict:
    """Live per-turn RAG lookup over legal_poc.db triggered by the opponent's latest courtroom statements."""
    path = Path(db_path)
    if not path.exists():
        return {"authorities": [], "citations": []}

    focus_text = " ".join(recent_lines[-3:]) if recent_lines else scenario
    combined = f"{focus_text} {scenario}"
    domain = detect_legal_domain(combined, "auto")
    fts_expr = _fts_expression(focus_text or scenario)
    prefer_exceptions = any(k in (speaker_role or "").lower() for k in ("defense", "respondent", "accused", "opposite"))

    authorities: list[dict] = []
    citations: list[str] = []
    try:
        with closing(sqlite3.connect(path)) as conn:
            conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
            dom_clause = (
                "AND l.domain IN ('ni_act_138', 'contract_breach', 'both', 'constitution')"
                if domain == "both"
                else "AND l.domain IN (?, 'both', 'constitution')"
            )
            dom_params = [fts_expr] if domain == "both" else [fts_expr, domain]
            proviso_boost = " - (l.has_proviso * 1.5) - (l.has_non_obstante * 1.0)" if prefer_exceptions else ""
            stat_rows = conn.execute(
                f"""
                SELECT l.chunk_id, l.title, l.section_number, l.has_proviso, l.has_non_obstante, l.text
                FROM legal_fts f
                JOIN legislation_provisions l ON l.chunk_id = f.item_id
                WHERE f.legal_fts MATCH ? AND f.category = 'legislation' {dom_clause}
                ORDER BY (bm25(f.legal_fts){proviso_boost}) ASC
                LIMIT ?
                """,
                [*dom_params, max(1, limit_statutes)],
            ).fetchall()
            for r in stat_rows:
                sec = r["section_number"] or "Provision"
                label = f"{r['title']} s.{sec}" if not str(sec).startswith("Article") else f"{r['title']} {sec}"
                flags = []
                if r["has_proviso"]:
                    flags.append("proviso/exception")
                if r["has_non_obstante"]:
                    flags.append("non-obstante")
                authorities.append({
                    "kind": "statute",
                    "citation": label,
                    "flags": flags,
                    "excerpt": _clean_excerpt(r["text"], 320),
                })
                if label not in citations:
                    citations.append(label)

            j_dom_clause = (
                "AND c.domain IN ('ni_act_138', 'contract_breach', 'both')"
                if domain in ("both", "constitution")
                else "AND c.domain IN (?, 'both')"
            )
            j_params = [fts_expr] if domain in ("both", "constitution") else [fts_expr, domain]
            sec_pref = (
                "WHEN jc.section_type IN ('arguments', 'ratio_decidendi', 'analysis', 'conclusion') THEN 2"
                if prefer_exceptions
                else "WHEN jc.section_type IN ('ratio_decidendi', 'conclusion', 'judgment', 'analysis') THEN 2"
            )
            case_rows = conn.execute(
                f"""
                SELECT jc.case_id, jc.section_type, jc.text, c.title, c.court, c.bench_strength,
                       c.year, c.citation, c.case_number, c.disposition
                FROM legal_fts f
                JOIN judgment_chunks jc ON jc.chunk_id = f.item_id
                JOIN judgment_cases c ON c.case_id = jc.case_id
                WHERE f.legal_fts MATCH ? AND f.category = 'judgment' {j_dom_clause}
                ORDER BY (
                    bm25(f.legal_fts)
                    - (c.hierarchy_weight * 0.035)
                    - (CASE {sec_pref} ELSE 0 END)
                ) ASC
                LIMIT 18
                """,
                j_params,
            ).fetchall()
            seen_cases: set[str] = set()
            for r in case_rows:
                cid = r["case_id"]
                if cid in seen_cases:
                    continue
                seen_cases.add(cid)
                cite_ref = r["citation"] or r["case_number"] or cid
                label = f"{r['title']} ({cite_ref}, {r['court']}, Bench: {r['bench_strength']}, {r['Disposition' if 'Disposition' in r.keys() else 'disposition'] or 'DECIDED'})"
                short_cite = f"{(r['title'] or cid)[:48]} ({cite_ref}, {r['court']})"
                authorities.append({
                    "kind": "precedent",
                    "citation": label,
                    "section_type": r["section_type"],
                    "excerpt": _clean_excerpt(r["text"], 340),
                })
                if short_cite not in citations:
                    citations.append(short_cite)
                if len(seen_cases) >= limit_precedents:
                    break
    except sqlite3.Error:
        return {"authorities": [], "citations": []}

    return {"authorities": authorities, "citations": citations}

"""Indian Courtroom Trial simulation: Bench, Opposing Counsel, Witnesses & Jury Panel with live per-turn Legal RAG."""
from __future__ import annotations

from threading import Event

from .legal import retrieve_turn_authorities
from .town import MEMORY_LINES, Utterance

COURT_ROLES = (
    "Presiding Judge (Bench)",
    "Complainant / Plaintiff Lead Counsel",
    "Accused / Respondent Defense Counsel",
    "Complainant / Plaintiff Key Witness",
    "Accused / Respondent Key Witness",
    "Foreperson of the Jury & Assessor Panel",
    "Jury Member (Banking & Commercial Assessor)",
    "Jury Member (Statutory & Evidentiary Assessor)",
    "Junior Counsel for Complainant / Plaintiff",
    "Junior Counsel for Accused / Respondent",
)

COURT_INSTRUCTIONS = (
    "You are participating in an Indian courtroom trial simulation on the supplied case scenario. "
    "Speak in the first person in your assigned courtroom role (Presiding Judge on the Bench, Complainant/Plaintiff Counsel, "
    "Accused/Respondent Defense Counsel, Party/Witness, or Jury/Assessor Panel Member). "
    "React directly to the opponent lawyer's or witness's latest statements in conversation: counter their factual claims, "
    "cite specific sections/provisos from live_rag_authorities and your evidence, and invoke or distinguish Supreme Court "
    "and High Court precedents (remembering that under Article 141 of the Constitution of India, Supreme Court judgments "
    "and larger Benches bind High Courts and smaller Benches). "
    "If you are Counsel, argue sharply from the statutory ingredients, provisos, limitation rules, and retrieved precedents. "
    "If you are a Witness, testify concretely to the timeline, documents, notices, payments, or contract performance. "
    "If you are on the Jury / Assessor Panel, evaluate whether each statutory ingredient and burden of proof is satisfied "
    "and state your verdict clearly in the final stage. "
    "If you are the Presiding Judge, test both counsel with pointed legal questions and, on the final turn of the trial, "
    "pronounce a reasoned Bench Order & Verdict after considering the Jury Panel's findings and binding precedents. "
    "text is two to four natural courtroom sentences. view is your honest current legal assessment of the case after this "
    "moment in one or two first-person sentences; shift compares it with opening_view."
)


def court_role_for_slot(index_one_based: int) -> str:
    if 1 <= index_one_based <= len(COURT_ROLES):
        return COURT_ROLES[index_one_based - 1]
    return f"Jury Assessor #{index_one_based - len(COURT_ROLES) + 3}"


def classify_court_seat(role: str | None, index_one_based: int) -> str:
    lower = (role or "").lower()
    if any(k in lower for k in ("judge", "justice", "bench", "magistrate", "presiding")):
        return "bench"
    if any(k in lower for k in ("jury", "juror", "foreperson", "assessor")):
        return "jury"
    if any(k in lower for k in ("witness", "deponent")):
        return "witness"
    if any(k in lower for k in ("defense", "defence", "respondent", "accused", "opposite")):
        return "defense"
    if any(k in lower for k in ("complainant", "plaintiff", "petitioner", "claimant", "prosecut", "appellant")):
        return "petitioner"
    fallback = ("bench", "petitioner", "defense", "witness", "witness", "jury", "jury", "jury", "petitioner", "defense")
    return fallback[(index_one_based - 1) % len(fallback)]


def stage_title(tick: int, total_rounds: int) -> str:
    if tick == 1:
        return "Stage 1: Opening Submissions, Statutory Ingredients & Framing of Issues"
    if tick >= total_rounds:
        return "Stage 3: Final Arguments, Jury Deliberation & Bench Verdict"
    return f"Stage {tick}: Witness Cross-Examination & Live Precedent Rebuttal"


def schedule_court(config, agents) -> list[list[dict]]:
    by_seat: dict[str, list[int]] = {"bench": [], "petitioner": [], "defense": [], "witness": [], "jury": []}
    for idx, agent in enumerate(agents, 1):
        seat = classify_court_seat(getattr(agent, "role", ""), idx)
        by_seat[seat].append(agent.id)

    all_ids = [agent.id for agent in agents]
    bench = by_seat["bench"] or [all_ids[0]]
    pet = by_seat["petitioner"] or [all_ids[min(1, len(all_ids) - 1)]]
    defn = by_seat["defense"] or [all_ids[min(2, len(all_ids) - 1)]]
    wit = by_seat["witness"]
    jury = by_seat["jury"]

    plan: list[list[dict]] = []
    for tick in range(1, config.rounds + 1):
        if tick == 1:
            # Judge opens -> Petitioner Counsel -> Defense Counsel -> Witnesses -> Jury initial questions -> Counsel reply -> Judge frames issues
            base_order = [*bench[:1], *pet, *defn, *wit, *jury, *pet[:1], *defn[:1], *bench[:1]]
        elif tick < config.rounds:
            # Witnesses -> Cross-exam by Counsel -> Judge questions -> Jury assessment -> Rebuttal
            base_order = [*wit, *pet, *defn, *bench, *jury, *defn[:1], *pet[:1]]
        else:
            # Closing arguments -> Full Jury deliberation & votes -> Presiding Judge final Order & Verdict last
            base_order = [*pet, *defn, *wit, *jury, *pet[:1], *defn[:1], *bench]

        # Ensure every persona speaks at least once in each tick and respect conversation_minutes floor
        seen = set()
        ordered: list[int] = []
        for aid in base_order + all_ids:
            if aid not in seen or len(ordered) >= len(all_ids):
                ordered.append(aid)
                seen.add(aid)
        target_turns = max(config.conversation_minutes, len(all_ids) + 2)
        while len(ordered) < target_turns:
            ordered.append(all_ids[len(ordered) % len(all_ids)])
        # In the final tick, always end with the Presiding Judge delivering the Bench Verdict
        if tick == config.rounds and bench and ordered[-1] != bench[0]:
            ordered.append(bench[0])

        plan.append([{
            "id": 1,
            "stage": stage_title(tick, config.rounds),
            "members": all_ids,
            "turns": ordered,
        }])
    return plan


def court_calls(config, agents) -> int:
    return sum(len(group["turns"]) for tick in schedule_court(config, agents) for group in tick)


def run_court(config, agents, model, emit, cancelled):
    cast = {agent.id: agent for agent in agents}
    seats = {agent.id: classify_court_seat(agent.role, idx) for idx, agent in enumerate(agents, 1)}
    opening = {
        agent.id: (agent.profile.initial_view if agent.profile and agent.profile.initial_view else agent.perspective)
        for agent in agents
    }
    memory = {identity: {"view": view, "heard": []} for identity, view in opening.items()}
    failed = Event()
    stopped = lambda: cancelled() or failed.is_set()

    for tick, groups in enumerate(schedule_court(config, agents), 1):
        if stopped():
            break
        group = groups[0]
        stage = group["stage"]
        emit(
            "groups_formed",
            {
                "tick": tick,
                "groups": [{"id": group["id"], "stage": stage, "members": group["members"]}],
            },
        )
        lines: list[str] = []
        previous = None
        try:
            for index, speaker in enumerate(group["turns"]):
                if stopped():
                    break
                agent = cast[speaker]
                rag = retrieve_turn_authorities(
                    config.scenario,
                    lines[-3:] + memory[speaker]["heard"][-2:],
                    speaker_role=agent.role,
                )
                emit("decision_start", {"agent_id": speaker, "tick": tick, "platform": "court"})
                result = model.generate(
                    Utterance,
                    COURT_INSTRUCTIONS,
                    {
                        "scenario": config.scenario,
                        "tick": tick,
                        "hearing_stage": stage,
                        "minute": index + 1,
                        "turns_left": len(group["turns"]) - index - 1,
                        "you": {
                            "name": agent.name,
                            "role": agent.role,
                            "court_seat": seats[speaker],
                            "perspective": agent.perspective,
                            "profile": agent.profile.model_dump() if agent.profile else None,
                            "evidence": agent.graph_context,
                        },
                        "live_rag_authorities": rag["authorities"],
                        "opening_view": opening[speaker],
                        "current_view": memory[speaker]["view"],
                        "memories": memory[speaker]["heard"],
                        "group": [
                            {"name": cast[m].name, "role": cast[m].role, "seat": seats[m]}
                            for m in group["members"]
                            if m != speaker
                        ],
                        "conversation": lines[-12:],
                    },
                    750,
                    cancelled=stopped,
                )
                result = Utterance.model_validate(result.model_dump())
                memory[speaker]["view"] = result.view
                effect_id = f"court:{tick}:{group['id']}:{index + 1}"
                emit(
                    "effect",
                    {
                        "effect_id": effect_id,
                        "agent_id": speaker,
                        "platform": "court",
                        "kind": "say",
                        "tick": tick,
                        "simulation_minute": (tick - 1) * config.minutes_per_round + index + 1,
                        "visibility": "public",
                        "outcome": "committed",
                        "origin": "decision",
                        "view": result.view,
                        "shift": result.shift,
                        "data": {
                            "content": result.text,
                            "group": group["id"],
                            "stage": stage,
                            "seat": seats[speaker],
                            "rag_citations": rag["citations"],
                            "members": group["members"],
                            "turn": index + 1,
                            "reply_to_effect": previous,
                        },
                    },
                )
                emit("decision_complete", {"agent_id": speaker, "tick": tick, "platform": "court"})
                lines.append(f"{agent.name} ({agent.role}): {result.text}")
                previous = effect_id
        except Exception:
            failed.set()
            raise

        for member in group["members"]:
            memory[member]["heard"] = (
                memory[member]["heard"] + [f"Tick {tick} ({stage}), {line}"[:500] for line in lines]
            )[-MEMORY_LINES:]

        if cancelled():
            break
        emit("tick_complete", {"tick": tick, "simulation_minute": tick * config.minutes_per_round, "successful": True})

    return {"status": "cancelled" if cancelled() else "completed"}

def test_courtroom_simulation_with_live_rag_and_jury_bench_verdict(self):
        import tempfile

        rag = retrieve_turn_authorities(
            "Dishonour of security cheque under Section 138 Negotiable Instruments Act",
            ["Defense Counsel: The cheque was given as a security deposit and stop payment was issued due to defective goods."],
            speaker_role="Complainant / Plaintiff Lead Counsel",
        )
        self.assertTrue(rag["authorities"])
        self.assertTrue(rag["citations"])

        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            store = Store(Path(tmp) / "runs.db")
            model = FakeModel()
            manager = Manager(store, model, engine=FixtureEngine(model))
            run = manager.create({
                "scenario": "Cheque dishonour under Section 138 NI Act for a security cheque after stop-payment instructions.",
                "agent_count": 8,
                "rounds": 3,
                "platform_mode": "court",
                "conversation_minutes": 6,
            })
            manager.worker.join(5)
            prepared = store.get(run["id"])
            self.assertEqual(prepared["status"], "ready")
            self.assertIn("INDIAN JURISDICTION LEGAL DOSSIER", prepared["config"]["source"])
            roles = [a["role"] for a in prepared["agents"]]
            self.assertEqual(roles[0], court_role_for_slot(1))  # Presiding Judge (Bench)
            self.assertIn("Complainant / Plaintiff Lead Counsel", roles)
            self.assertIn("Accused / Respondent Defense Counsel", roles)
            self.assertTrue(any("Jury" in r for r in roles))

            manager.start(run["id"])
            manager.worker.join(10)
            finished = store.get(run["id"])
            self.assertEqual(finished["status"], "completed")
            court_actions = [a for a in finished["actions"] if a.get("platform") == "court"]
            self.assertEqual(
                len(court_actions),
                court_calls(Config.model_validate(finished["config"]), [
                    type("Obj", (), {"id": a["id"], "role": a["role"]}) for a in finished["agents"]
                ]),
            )
            self.assertTrue(all(a["data"].get("rag_citations") for a in court_actions))
            # Final turn of the final stage is delivered by the Presiding Judge (agent_id == 1)
            self.assertEqual(court_actions[-1]["agent_id"], 1)
            self.assertIn("Stage 3", court_actions[-1]["data"]["stage"])
            court_payloads = [p for p in model.payloads if "live_rag_authorities" in p]
            self.assertTrue(court_payloads and all(p["live_rag_authorities"] for p in court_payloads))
